svg.title: Milo is one Node.js process and a few services
svg.desc: Architecture diagram. Telegram, where the athlete talks to Milo, and a Strava webhook fired after each session wake Milo, as do cron jobs for the recap, planner and memory. Milo is one Node.js process on Railway, written in TypeScript with Fastify and grammY. It calls the Claude API with Sonnet and Haiku, the Strava API for activity history, Google Calendar through MCP to book the plan, Intervals.icu for sleep, readiness and weight, and OpenAI for literature embeddings. Neon Postgres sits under everything and holds all state.
